## Current focus
VaultSpark Studios is actively building browser games, intelligence tooling, and member systems. IGNIS — the studio's in-browser analytics and recommendation layer — surfaces game-context suggestions and powers push notification segmentation for Vault Members. Free enrollment is open at https://vaultsparkstudios.com/membership/.
